entries.title: Find protected secrets and signed-in sites on one page
entries.body: Search or add protected secrets in the first list, then see each signed-in site's access rule in the second. The protected list's footer opens saved decisions, approving devices, use history and recovery. How secrets are stored and approved has not changed.

picture.alt: Secrets settings showing two protected secret rows, their management footer, and a signed-in site set to Ask me each time
